jordan_sales: Heads-up — acme trial is intermittently hitting 500s on long prompts. Demo tomorrow 10am PST, theyre nervous. Can we triage? :rotating_light:
acme_poc_team: Sharing a quick snippet from our side, we saw a spike of 500s and queue depth jumps:
```
ERROR inference 500: request timed out after 6.0s
x-queue-depth: 42
request_id: req_0a9c
```
mike_sre: :eyes: Is that on hosted trial pool or a dedicated test cluster? Need region and pool id to check metrics
acme_poc_team: Hosted trial in us-west2, pool tag: trial-acme-usw2
tanvi_eng: OK pinging logs/metrics. Can you confirm average tokens / batch size / streaming?
acme_poc_team: Long prompts ~3000 tokens, batch size 1, streaming disabled, app concurrency ~20 requests/sec
mike_sre: That combination + cold-worker compile can spike queue depth and cause 5xx. Short-term workaround: drop concurrency to 6 or gate requests at proxy
jordan_sales: I'll ask their eng to throttle on their side. Any mitigation we can do quickly?
tanvi_eng: Quick actions on our side:
- enable streaming (reduces tail latency)
- reduce max_tokens to 1024 for demo
- switch to lighter variant rwd-instruct-small for the demo endpoint
- manual scale: `rictl pool scale trial-acme-usw2 --replicas 4` (pre-warms workers)
emily: Heads up — manual scaling for the trial will increase short-term cost. Jordan if we approve bump, Ill notify acct exec for the demo window
mike_sre: Running manual scale now, tailing logs. Command: `rictl pool scale trial-acme-usw2 --replicas 4`
deploy-bot: Deployment event: scaled pool trial-acme-usw2 1 -> 4 at 2311110123 by mike_sre
acme_poc_team: After the scale we dropped from ~10% errors to ~1-2%, still see a couple 500s at peak. Sending request_id=req_0a9c for a sample
tanvi_eng: Can you attach full request/response for req_0a9c and include headers? Also add header `x-allow-fallback: true` to allow runtime fallback to smaller variant while we debug
mike_sre: I added a temporary routing rule to bump this customers priority and raised queue depth threshold. Monitoring charts now, q-depth trending down
jordan_sales: Customer relieved for now but wants RCA. Next steps?
tanvi_eng: Root cause hypothesis: long-seq inference hit heavy compile/hot-start on the optimized kernels causing worker CPU/GPU contention and autoscaler lag. Plan: 1) reproduce with 3k tokens and warmup, 2) add prewarm on the onboarding hook, 3) add micro-benchmark to trial docs. I'll open a follow-up ticket and assign to eng-oncall
jordan_sales: Please cc sales + support on ticket. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
